deferrals.summary: No session-wide pymysql.connect recorder is committed, so criterion 3's proof is not implemented.
deferrals.explanation: The criterion's 'Proof:' names a run, not a committed mechanism; the issue's Testing Strategy item 3 reads 'A one-off session-wide run with pymysql.connect replaced by a recorder that raises, failing the session if it recorded any call ... It is a verification run for the PR'. Re-run at 0361d68 and at this commit with the rig .prflow/tmp/implement/381/rig/connect_recorder.py (pytest -p connect_recorder; replaces pymysql.connect, Connect and Connection.connect at configure; sets exitstatus 1 at sessionfinish on any call): 0 calls recorded, recorder still installed at session end, 3433 passed. Every test that reaches connect supplies its own fake (test_cli.py autouse fixture, test_preflight.py patches, fake-module tests).
